channelCoverage.closed: filled — a reconstructed siege-abandoned outcome, or an open whose army is gone

channelCoverage.defenderId: filled — reconstructed from the outcome id prefix
channelCoverage.terminalOutcomes: filled — conquest and razing outcomes accumulated across every interior tick
channelCoverage.loserDied: filled — the defender save died flag
channelCoverage.treatyWritten: filled — the treaty ledger, keyed by the real treatyPairKey minter
channelCoverage.peaceReason: unfilled — no peace reason reaches the composed year result; warTermination publishes bands and a deciding term, not the reason token classifyWarEnding reads
channelCoverage.coalitionFragmented: unfilled — coalition fracture facts need coalitionLedgerEnabled, which no shipped preset lights
channelCoverage.seatTransitionFamily: unfilled — the WR-5 governed families need lineageClaimEnabled, which no shipped preset lights
